name: Копирайтинг для площадки
description: Продающий текст под конкретную площадку: лендинг, Instagram, email, Google Ads, Telegram

slots.description: Главная выгода клиента в одном предложении

slots.label: Целевая аудитория
slots.description: Кому продаём и что для них важно

rules.description: Instagram: лимит первой строки и хештеги
rules.append: Instagram notes: first line up to 120 characters (it is cut in the feed), add 3-5 relevant hashtags at the end, no links in the body.
Email notes: provide a subject line under 45 characters plus complementary preview text; CTA button text of 2-3 words.
Google Ads notes: headlines up to 30 characters, descriptions up to 90 characters; include the main keyword in a headline.
Telegram notes: 1-3 short paragraphs, line breaks for rhythm, one emoji max per paragraph, end with a single call to action.
Landing page notes: write a headline, subheadline, 3 benefit bullets, and a CTA button label as separate blocks.

examples:
Write marketing copy in русском for a landing page.
Product: онлайн-курс по SQL для аналитиков
Key benefit: за 6 недель научиться писать сложные запросы без подсказок
Target audience: аналитики, которые засели на джойнах
Call to action: записаться на бесплатный вводный урок

Requirements:
- The first 1-2 lines must hook attention: no generic greetings, no 'именно сейчас'.
- Sell benefits, not features; use simple concrete words.
- One core message and exactly one call to action.
- Keep it tight and scannable; cut every filler sentence.

Return only the copy.

Landing page notes: write a headline, subheadline, 3 benefit bullets, and a CTA button label as separate blocks.
